mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the chromosome copies with the spindle was most worthwhile: the planned intermediate inset connects their movement to the formation of two nuclei before the cell itself divides.

leastWorthwhile.text: The growth result was informative but repeated its picture description as the wonder, adding little beyond the initial result.

surprise.text: The final picture extended the immediate division into a population, including cells retained for further division.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the supplied pictures and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the sequence connected familiar DNA replication to the less familiar mechanics of chromosome separation and cell division, and I would be curious to see how the descendants specialize.
